brief: The canvas depicts a tranquil, deep-water surface, constantly exhibiting gentle, flowing ripples that convey a sense of calm movement. The water maintains its fluid, unbroken quality until an external sound source is detected. As the sound level increases, the surface reacts dynamically: the subtle ripples become more pronounced, growing in fragmentation and brightness, culminating in a highly visible, sparkling effect when the sound peaks.

statement: This sketch creates a serene water surface that responds dynamically to sound input. Under normal conditions, gentle ripples flow across the canvas in a calming, continuous motion. When sound is detected—triggered by a 440 Hz tone in the test—the ripples intensify, fragment, and brighten into a sparkling effect that visually represents the increase in audio energy. The interaction is entirely self-contained: it begins on user click to activate audio, then reacts to simulated sound input without any external controls.
